request_description: Fast-paced battle theme with driving drums and brass fanfares, high intensity combat music

spec.description: A high-intensity battle theme driven by thunderous orchestral drums and blazing brass fanfares, with surging strings and aggressive rhythmic momentum. Punchy percussive hits and heroic horn stabs push the energy forward relentlessly, evoking the chaos and excitement of epic combat.
spec.style_hint: Nobuo Uematsu / Yoko Shimomura orchestral battle theme, Final Fantasy or Kingdom Hearts style

request_description: Epic orchestral boss battle theme with heavy percussion, choir, and dark dramatic tension

spec.description: A thunderous orchestral boss battle theme surging with heavy taiko drums and driving timpani, dark choir voices chanting in low, menacing tones beneath sweeping brass fanfares and aggressive string ostinatos. Tension builds relentlessly with dissonant horn stabs, crashing cymbals, and a grand, overwhelming sense of dread and power.
spec.style_hint: Yasunori Mitsuda and Hitoshi Sakimoto epic JRPG final boss style, reminiscent of Final Fantasy XII and Xenoblade Chronicles orchestral grandeur

request_description: Gentle exploration theme with acoustic guitar and flute, evoking a sunlit meadow

spec.description: A gentle, warm exploration theme featuring fingerpicked acoustic guitar weaving soft melodic lines beneath an airy solo flute. The atmosphere is peaceful and sun-drenched, evoking a wide open meadow bathed in golden afternoon light, with a sense of quiet wonder and discovery.
spec.style_hint: Studio Ghibli field theme, Yoko Shimomura nature area style

request_description: Deep space ambient music with low drones, shimmer textures, and subtle evolving tones

spec.description: Vast, otherworldly ambient soundscape built from deep sub-bass drones and slowly evolving shimmer textures. Ethereal synthesizer pads drift and morph over long sustains, layered with subtle metallic resonances and distant cosmic tones that breathe and pulse with quiet intensity.
spec.style_hint: Brian Eno ambient style meets sci-fi video game atmosphere, Mass Effect deep space exploration

request_description: Curious wandering music with plucked strings and light woodwinds, sense of discovery

spec.description: A light, meandering melody carried by plucked strings and airy woodwinds, evoking the feeling of exploring an unknown land with wide-eyed wonder. Gentle pizzicato and soft flute phrases weave together over a sparse, open texture, creating a sense of curious discovery and quiet adventure.
spec.style_hint: Studio Ghibli-inspired orchestral score, Yoko Shimomura exploration theme

request_description: Dark and tense dungeon crawl music with low strings, sparse percussion, and eerie echoes

spec.description: A dark and tense dungeon crawl underscore built on slowly bowing low strings that hover uneasily beneath sparse, distant percussion strikes. Eerie echoing tones and hollow ambient textures create a suffocating sense of dread, as if danger lurks just beyond the torchlight.
spec.style_hint: classic JRPG dungeon ambient, Yasunori Mitsuda dark orchestral style

request_description: Melancholy piano piece with slow tempo, minor key, and a feeling of loss and longing

spec.description: A solitary, melancholy piano piece drifting through sparse melodic phrases, with gentle sustain and soft dynamic swells that evoke a deep sense of loss and longing. The tone is intimate and introspective, like a quiet farewell — bare piano notes hanging in silence, resonating with emotional weight.
spec.style_hint: Nobuo Uematsu or Yoko Shimomura emotional ballad style, reminiscent of JRPG farewell scenes

request_description: Nostalgic 16-bit era title theme with chiptune arpeggios layered over modern synth pads

spec.description: A warm, nostalgic title screen theme blending crisp 16-bit chiptune arpeggios and square-wave leads with lush modern synthesizer pads underneath, evoking childhood wonder and adventure. The chiptune melody dances playfully over slowly evolving ambient synth layers, bridging retro pixel-art aesthetics with contemporary production depth.
spec.style_hint: SNES 16-bit era title screen, Yasunori Mitsuda meets modern synthwave production

request_description: Short triumphant victory jingle with bright brass, rising scales, and celebratory energy

spec.description: A short, triumphant victory jingle bursting with bright brass fanfare and rapidly rising scale runs. Celebratory orchestral flourishes build from a crisp snare roll into a punchy, exuberant climax, radiating pure joy and accomplishment.
spec.style_hint: classic JRPG victory fanfare, Nobuo Uematsu Final Fantasy victory theme era

request_description: Something that sounds like a video game

spec.description: Upbeat chiptune melody with punchy 8-bit arpeggios and bouncy square-wave leads, layered over a driving retro drum machine beat. Bright, catchy, and full of nostalgic energy reminiscent of classic arcade and console game soundtracks.
spec.style_hint: classic NES/SNES era platformer, early Nintendo style
